parameters.prompt: The exact flying falcon in the reference performs ONE ordinary feather-shot attack while hovering in place. From the hovering pose it draws the head back and lifts both wings high, then thrusts the head and beak forward toward screen left with the beak open while both wings beat down hard once, holds for a brief moment, then closes the beak and returns to the exact original hovering pose and holds it. Keep the same three-quarter left view, plumage, beak and wing shape. Exactly two wings and two legs. No flying across the frame, turning around, diving, second attack, extra limbs. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character including both wingtips stays inside the frame with wide margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, glow, energy, liquid, spray, projectile, feathers flying off, particles, dust, shadow or text.
